prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create one production bitmap UI asset for the existing for-pocket cute minimal expense notebook app: a small thick stack of Japanese-style banknotes wrapped with one pale butter-yellow paper band. Muted sage-green bills, warm ivory edges, simple rounded corners, very soft hand-painted flat gouache texture, simple chunky silhouette readable at 48 pixels, no glossy highlights, no sparkles, no faces, no arms, no shadows outside the object, no surrounding decorations. Three-quarter view tilted slightly up to the right, one single cash bundle only centered in square canvas, subject filling 88% width. The band has a single tiny simple yen symbol ¥, no other text, no numbers, no logos. Genuine fully transparent PNG background with clean alpha edges, not a checkerboard painted behind it. It is the clickable save icon and will fly into a small soft cloud mascot; cute, restrained stationery feel, not photorealistic and not an SVG illustration.
